posts.title: Challenge Is Gone
posts.description: All my life I have consciously and unconsciously strived for different things. Consciously, I pursued the goals society set for me: make money, be useful, have children, and so on. posts.title: Cloudflare Email Routing
posts.description: TIL that you can use Cloudflare Email Routing to set up free email on your domain. It basically routes from ceo-bob@your-company-domain.com to your private bob@gmail.com for free. So you don’t have to pay for Gmail for business until your business makes money :-) Here is a step-by-step guide by Gulshan Kumar.
